newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STABLE TO WEAKER IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STABLE TO WEAKER IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: Trade on Zimbabwe's interbank market resumed quietly on Monday from the weekend break with the local unit quoted stable on the U.S. dollar but weaker on other hard currencies, reflecting overseas market trends.
"The dollar has remained where it was on Friday (against the U.S. unit). There's hardly been any activity in the (local) market today," commented one dealer.
At around 0810 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was unchanged at 11.3150/3250 against the U.S. money but eased versus sterling to 18.3635/3750 from 18.2300/2500, tracking a softer U.S. dollar overseas.
Against the mark it was quoted at 6.5520/5550 from 6.5500/5700 and was also down on the rand at 2.5475/5505 compared to 2.5400/5600.
